[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Config schema for `values: priority`[/bold #D7AFFF]                          [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]config[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]config: teach the bullet-property config loader a `values: priority` [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]kind with a validated `levels` list (label, value, day range) and a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`schedules` target, and add the `priority` entry to the chezmoi-managed [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]bob/config.yml.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Priority value stage and single-task write[/bold #D7AFFF]                    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]picker[dim] · [dim][/dim]after config[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]picker: render the P2/P3/P4 value stage, roll a random date from the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]chosen level's day range, and write the priority field plus the derived [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]scheduled value in one guarded edit that reuses the existing [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Blocked/recovery and project-frontmatter behavior.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Counted-session priority writes[/bold #D7AFFF]                               [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]counted[dim] · [dim][/dim]after picker[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]counted: extend the counted batch planner so N<Ctrl+Shift+P> applies one[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]priority to every counted task while rolling an independent scheduled [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]date per task.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Priority-derived suggestion in the date picker[/bold #D7AFFF]                [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]suggest[dim] · [dim][/dim]after picker[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]suggest: pin a visually distinct, re-rollable suggested date at the top [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]of the `scheduled` value stage whenever the current task (or every [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]counted task) already has a priority.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]

    [#AF87FF]release[dim] · [dim][/dim]after counted, suggest[/#AF87FF][/dim]
